summary: Adds a new Error Prone check, JSpecifyUnrecognizedAnnotationLocation, that reports nullness annotations in locations JSpecify does not recognize, with suggested fixes, and runs it over NullAway's own sources and test inputs.

tests.evidence: New 943-line checker; CodeRabbit found duplicated fixtures (outerTypeThroughArrayDimensions vs qualifiedInnerTypeInArrayIsReported, and a second pair); the initial tests pinned the wide annotation set (nonJSpecifyTypeUseAnnotationsAreReported) that review then removed.

user_docs.evidence: New user-facing check and severity/flag semantics with no docs in the initial version; NullAway documents checks such as RequireExplicitNullMarking in its wiki.

doc_comments.evidence: msridhar could not follow classifyTypeUsage comments ('a type parameter keeps its fix', 'reachable through two TreePaths', 'recognized nesting step', undefined 'root type'); fixed in c81527be, bbc12cd9, ea737870, 887b9398.

change_description.evidence: No CHANGELOG entry in the initial version (final adds an Unreleased entry); unrelated renames in AndroidTest/GrpcTest drew 'Why are there changes in this file?' from the reviewer.

performance.evidence: The checker matches every annotated type, class, method, variable and new-array tree in every compilation; work is cheap per tree and gated by annotation presence, so a glance suffices.

backward_compat.evidence: Initial ships at SeverityLevel.WARNING, so every NullAway user gets new warnings on upgrade and -Werror builds break (the Caffeine snapshot job went red); final ships at SUGGESTION and reports nothing by default.

error_model.evidence: The check's product is 19 diagnostic phrases plus suggested fixes; message wording and fix shapes need a focused look.

correctness.evidence: Large tree-walking classification (two TreePaths reaching one AnnotatedTypeTree, covered nested types, qualifier anchors, fix placement) is non-trivial logic.

user_value.evidence: New feature; reviewer challenged scope (reporting all NullAway-recognized annotations rather than JSpecify's) and it was narrowed; CheckLocalVariableRootType added for JetBrains migrants.

surprising_behavior.evidence: Initial matched any TYPE_USE annotation named Nullable/NonNull/NotNull/Nonnull, telling Checker Framework and JetBrains users an annotation is meaningless where their own tool reads it (msridhar 2026-09-02); plus on-by-default warnings.

contradictions.evidence: Description and code were revised together; unrelated identifier renames were explained in commit messages.

build_ci.evidence: Changes nullaway/build.gradle (buildWithNullAway runs the check at ERROR), sample/build.gradle, and the shared test harness so every test runs the check; Caffeine-with-snapshot integration job is red on this branch.

spec_conformance.evidence: Implements the JSpecify recognized-locations section; initial applied it to non-JSpecify annotations, which the spec does not cover (narrowed in 1d2c86b2).

plan.why: A large new checker whose logic, default/scope policy, comments and diagnostics, and build/harness wiring are independent concerns.
